newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 15.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai stock exchange will invest $3 million this year to improved its technical system to strengthen supervision of stock trading.
- Hong Kong firms have invested a total of $6.52 billion in the Pudong development area, topping the foreign investment list in the zone.
- A commentary warns listed firms against blindly issuing high-priced rights shares.
- BUSINESS NEWS - A recent survey in Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin shows 60 percent of foreign-invested companies in China intend to expand their business in China.
- U.S. software giant Microsoft has signed two agreements with the Shanghai city government to increase cooperation in software technology and technical education.
